# health

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./singularity build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Makes browser storage visible: an error toast once per owner per page load when a write is refused (over the owner's cap, the area full, or storage blocked — the value then lives only in memory), and the health report's Browser storage row (critical when the browser refused a write, attention when an owner hit or nears its cap; its detail lists every owner's use against its cap plus the legacy and unowned keys).
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `WebStorageSlots.Root` → `StorageFailureToast`
    - `HealthReport.Row` "Browser storage" → `StorageDetail`
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/data-view.DataView`
    - `primitives/data-view.defineDataView`
    - `primitives/data-view.FieldDef`
    - `primitives/dom/web-storage.onStorageFailure`
    - `primitives/dom/web-storage.scanArea`
    - `primitives/dom/web-storage.StorageFailure`
    - `primitives/dom/web-storage.useStorageUsage`
    - `primitives/dom/web-storage.WebStorageSlots`
    - `shell/health-report.HealthReport`
    - `shell/toast.showToast`
